title: Crüger to Müller, 31 December 1634
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller written at Danzig on the day before the Kalends of January (31 December) 1634, now with a commission from the city council to find out what Kepler's posthumous papers and Tycho's observations would cost. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. Bb. 48). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 111.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Commissioned by the Danzig council, Crüger asks Müller for a catalogue of Kepler's papers for sale, and whether Tycho's observations are the widow's to sell.
